import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)

        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Offset grid to the right to avoid overlapping with lecture text
                x = 1.5 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.2 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):

        # Setup
        lecture_lines = [
            'Define the matrix exponential using an infinite Taylor series.',
            'It sums Identity, A, and higher powers of A.',
            'Scale each power by its corresponding factorial term.',
            'This recipe combines multiple matrices into one result.',
            'The series converges to a stable, single matrix operator.'

        formula = MathTex(
            "e^{A}", "=", "I", "+", "{A}", "+", "{1 \\over 2!}", "{A}^2", "+", "\\dots",

        self.place_in_area(formula, "A1", "B6", scale_factor=1.1)

            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW),

        self.wait(1)

            bracket_l = MathTex("[", font_size=60, color=color)
            bracket_r = MathTex("]", font_size=60, color=color)
            content = MathTex(label, font_size=30, color=color)

            return VGroup(bg, box)

        matrix_i = create_matrix_box("I")
        matrix_a = create_matrix_box("A", color=COLOR_A)
        matrix_a2 = create_matrix_box("{A^2 \\over 2!}", color=COLOR_A)

        # Positioning the stack in the lower area
        stack_center = "E3"
        self.place_at_grid(matrix_i, stack_center, scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(matrix_a, stack_center, scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(matrix_a2, stack_center, scale_factor=0.8)

        # Apply vertical/horizontal offsets for stacking effect
        matrix_a.shift(UP * 0.3 + RIGHT * 0.3)
        matrix_a2.shift(UP * 0.6 + RIGHT * 0.6)

        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(COLOR_TEXT),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(YELLOW),
            FadeIn(matrix_i)
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW),
            FadeIn(matrix_a)
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(matrix_a2))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 & 5 ===
        # Step 3: Animate the stacked layers collapsing (merging) into a single matrix labeled 'e^A'
        
        final_matrix = create_matrix_box("e^A", color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(final_matrix, stack_center, scale_factor=1.0)
        final_matrix.shift(UP * 0.3 + RIGHT * 0.3) 

        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(COLOR_TEXT),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(COLOR_TEXT),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(YELLOW),
            matrix_i.animate.move_to(final_matrix.get_center()),
            matrix_a.animate.move_to(final_matrix.get_center()),
            matrix_a2.animate.move_to(final_matrix.get_center()),
            run_time=1.5
        )

        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(COLOR_TEXT),
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(YELLOW),
            FadeOut(matrix_i),
            FadeOut(matrix_a),
            FadeOut(matrix_a2),

        )
